parameters.text:
=You write two short paragraphs for a card read by a person with no genetics background.

FACTS:
{{ $json.facts_text }}

Rules:
- Use ONLY the facts above. Never add a fact, study, percentage or number that is not written above.
- Write every number as digits (42, not Fortytwo; 2, not two).
- Do not interpret, guess or draw conclusions (for example, never say what a frequency "suggests"). Only restate facts in plain words.
- No medical advice. Do not change the label. Do not mention how many copies the person carries or their APOE type.
- Plain words, short sentences, at most 60 words per paragraph.
- If the condition the database links this change to is different from everyday cholesterol risk, say so plainly.
- If the person's own lab report and the database give different classifications, say that plainly in paragraph 1: it is the most useful thing on the card.

Output exactly two paragraphs separated by one blank line, with no headings, labels or bullet points, and nothing else:
Paragraph 1: what supports this evidence.
Paragraph 2: what weakens or disputes it. If nothing in the facts disputes it, say that plainly. This paragraph MUST include the South Asian frequency fact in plain words.

parameters.jsonBody: { "status": "awaiting_confirmation", "refusal_reason": "Extraction was not confirmed by the user, so no findings were generated." }

parameters.content:
## The gate

Nothing past this point runs unless the user confirmed the extraction. Path A sets user_confirmed=true automatically. Path B waits for a human to check the reading against the paper report.

## Rules, not a model

Apply Label Rules is plain arithmetic on what ClinVar returned. The model never sees this step and cannot change a label. Remove the model and every judgement here is identical.

nodes.name: Load Cached Evidence
nodes.notes: ATTACH THE SUPABASE CREDENTIAL HERE. Read before the live lookup so a cached answer can stand in if ClinVar is unreachable.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "query V($variantId: String!, $dataset: DatasetId!) { variant(variantId: $variantId, dataset: $dataset) { variant_id genome { ac an populations { id ac an } } exome { ac an populations { id ac an } } } }", variables: { variantId: $json.gnomad_id38, dataset: "gnomad_r4" } }) }}

nodes.name: Ask gnomAD
nodes.notes: No credential needed. Population frequency by ancestry group; the 'sas' population is South Asian. Dataset gnomad_r2_1 is on GRCh37, matching the panel.

nodes.name: Mark Processing
nodes.notes: Runs in parallel with the analysis so the upload immediately leaves awaiting_confirmation. Without this the app sends the user back to the confirm screen forever.

nodes.name: Clear Old Findings
nodes.notes: Analysing the same upload twice used to leave two copies of every card. This clears the previous run first. It runs on a side branch, seconds before Save Findings.

nodeGroups.name: Gate
nodeGroups.description: Reads the upload and stops unless the extraction was confirmed.

nodeGroups.name: Evidence lookup
nodeGroups.description: Finds the exact ClinVar record, asks gnomAD v4 for the South Asian frequency, caches the answer.

nodeGroups.name: Write the cards
nodeGroups.description: Labels come from rules; Groq writes two paragraphs that are checked for invented numbers before saving.
